question: What is 25-Ponders with reference to the celebration at the Republic Day Parade?

options.text: Salute by seven canons of the Indian Army
Salute to the National Flag by the President’s bodyguards
Presentation of the tableaus from different states

solution:
The correct answer is __**Salute by seven canons of the Indian Army**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **25-pounder guns were a type of British-era artillery that were used to fire the 21-gun salute during the Republic Day parade**.
 
• The **guns were replaced by 105 mm Indian field guns (IFGs) in 2023. **
 
• **The 25-pounder guns were designed and made in the 1940s** and were used in the 1965 and 1971 wars with Pakistan. 
 
• The guns were **decommissioned in the early 1990s and were only used for ceremonial purposes. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 21-gun **salute is fired to honor the President of India** and the national flag. 
 
• The **salute is given during the Republic Day parad**e, **Independence Day**, or to honor the country's supreme leader. 
 
• The 21-gun salute is** considered the highest honor of the count**ry. 
 
• The** IFGs are made in Indi**a and are compact, light, and can be airdropped.
